words.sanskrit: paramatmadrishtya tatpratyayalakshyani drishtva tadanu sarveshamaprameyamajam shivam paramakasham niralambamadvayam

meaning.en: seeing, by the vision of the supreme self, the signs confirming it, then the lord of all, unmeasurable, unborn, auspicious, the highest space, without support, without a second
meaning.hi: परमात्म-दृष्टि से उसके प्रत्यय-लक्ष्य देखकर, फिर सर्वेश, अप्रमेय, अज, शिव, परमाकाश, निरालम्ब, अद्वय

meaning.en: the single point toward which Brahma, Vishnu, Rudra and others converge, the cause of all, seeing this highest Brahman within the self alone
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-रुद्र आदि का एक लक्ष्य, सर्वकारण परब्रह्म को आत्मा में ही देखते हुए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then, like a withered tree, free of fainting, sleep, and the breath's movement, the pairs of opposites are destroyed
meaning.hi: फिर सूखे वृक्ष-सा, मूर्च्छा-निद्रा-श्वास-रहित, द्वन्द्व नष्ट

words.sanskrit: sadachanchalagatrah paramashantim svikritya manah pracharashunyam paramatmani linam bhavati

meaning.en: the body constantly still, having accepted deep peace, the mind with nowhere to wander becomes absorbed in the highest self
meaning.hi: शरीर सदा अचल, परम शान्ति स्वीकार कर, मन प्रचार-शून्य होकर परमात्मा में लीन होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: payahsravanantaram dhenustanaksheeramiva sarvendriyavarge parinashte manonasham bhavati

meaning.en: just as milk flows from a cow's udder naturally, once the whole group of senses has fallen away, the mind's activity ends
meaning.hi: जैसे गाय के थन से दूध बहता है, इन्द्रिय-वर्ग के नष्ट होने पर मन का नाश होता है

meaning.en: this itself is amanaska
meaning.hi: यही अमनस्क है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tadanu nityashuddhah paramatma aham eva iti tattvamasi ityupadeshena

meaning.en: then, through the teaching "tat tvam asi", one knows: I am always the pure supreme self
meaning.hi: फिर तत्त्वमसि उपदेश से: मैं सदा शुद्ध परमात्मा हूँ

words.sanskrit: tvamevahamahameva tvamiti tarakayogamargena akhandanandapurnah kritartho bhavati

meaning.en: "you are truly me, I am truly you" - through this path of tarakayoga, one becomes fulfilled, full of unbroken bliss
meaning.hi: "त्वमेवाहम्, अहमेव त्वम्" - तारकयोग-मार्ग से अखण्डानन्द-पूर्ण कृतार्थ होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: mind fully submerged in the highest space, having reached the state beyond mind, having renounced the whole group of senses
meaning.hi: परिपूर्ण पराकाश में मग्न मन, उन्मन्यवस्था प्राप्त, सर्वेन्द्रिय-वर्ग सन्न्यस्त

meaning.en: ripened through merit of many births, with all affliction destroyed by unbroken bliss, one becomes fulfilled thinking "I am Brahman"
meaning.hi: अनेक जन्मों के पुण्य से पक्व, अखण्डानन्द से क्लेश-नाश कर "मैं ब्रह्म हूँ" सोचते हुए कृतकृत्य होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: "you are me, there is no difference, because the highest self is by nature complete"
meaning.hi: "तू ही मैं है, कोई भेद नहीं, क्योंकि परमात्मा पूर्ण है"

meaning.en: saying this and embracing the student, the teacher led him into direct knowledge
meaning.hi: यह कहते हुए और शिष्य को आलिंगन कर, गुरु ने उसे ज्ञप्ति में ले गए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha ha yajnavalkyo mandalapurusham papraccha vyomapanchakalakshanam vistarena anubruhi iti

meaning.en: then Yajnavalkya asked Mandalapurusha: "describe to me in detail the nature of the five kinds of space"
meaning.hi: तब याज्ञवल्क्य ने मण्डलपुरुष से पूछा: "व्योमपञ्चक-लक्षण विस्तार से बताइए"

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa hovacha akasham parakasham mahakasham suryakasham paramakasham iti pancha bhavanti

meaning.en: he said: there are five: ordinary space, supreme space, great space, sun's space, highest space
meaning.hi: उन्होंने कहा: आकाश, पराकाश, महाकाश, सूर्याकाश, परमाकाश - ये पाँच हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: ordinary space, outer and inner, is filled with darkness
meaning.hi: बाह्याभ्यन्तर अन्धकारमय आकाश है

meaning.en: within its outer part, resembling the fire that ends an age, is the supreme space
meaning.hi: बाह्य के भीतर कालानल-सदृश पराकाश है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: full of limitless brilliance, outer and inner, this reality is the great space
meaning.hi: बाह्याभ्यन्तर अपरिमित-द्युति-निभ तत्त्व महाकाश है

meaning.en: resembling the sun, outer and inner, is the sun's space
meaning.hi: बाह्याभ्यन्तर सूर्य-निभ सूर्याकाश है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: beyond words, all-pervading, marked by unsurpassed bliss - this is the highest space
meaning.hi: अनिर्वचनीय ज्योति, सर्वव्यापक, निरतिशय-आनन्द-लक्षण परमाकाश है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: through seeing each of these in turn, one takes on that very nature
meaning.hi: उस-उस लक्ष्य-दर्शन से उस-उस रूप को धारण करता है

meaning.en: nine centres, six supports, three points of focus are involved in this fivefold space
meaning.hi: नवचक्र, षडाधार, त्रिलक्ष्य - यह व्योमपञ्चक है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: samyagetan na janati sa yogi namato bhavet

meaning.en: whoever does not properly know this is a yogi in name only
meaning.hi: जो इसे सम्यक् नहीं जानता, वह केवल नाम का योगी है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: savishayam mano bandhaya nirvishayam muktaye bhavati

meaning.en: a mind attached to objects leads to bondage; free of objects, it leads to liberation
meaning.hi: सविषय मन बन्धन के लिए, निर्विषय मुक्ति के लिए होता है

meaning.en: therefore the entire universe is within the range of the mind's perception
meaning.hi: अतः सर्व जगत् चित्तगोचर है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tadeva chittam nirashrayam manonmanyavasthaparipakvam layayogyam bhavati

meaning.en: that same mind, once free of support and matured in the state beyond mind, becomes fit for dissolution
meaning.hi: वही चित्त निराश्रय होकर उन्मन्यावस्था में परिपक्व होकर लय-योग्य होता है

meaning.en: one should practice that dissolving in me, who am already full
meaning.hi: उस लय का अभ्यास परिपूर्ण मुझमें करना चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: I myself am the cause of the mind's dissolution
meaning.hi: मनोलय का कारण मैं ही हूँ

words.sanskrit: anahatasya shabdasya tasya shabdasya yo dhvanih

meaning.en: there is an unstruck sound, and that sound has its own resonance
meaning.hi: अनाहत शब्द का जो ध्वनि है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: within the sound lies a light; within that light lies the mind
meaning.hi: ध्वनि के भीतर ज्योति, ज्योति के भीतर मन

meaning.en: that mind is what performs the work of the three worlds' creation, sustaining, and dissolution
meaning.hi: वह मन त्रिजगत् की सृष्टि-स्थिति-व्यसन-कर्म करता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tanmano vilayam yati tadvishnoh paramam padam

meaning.en: that mind comes to dissolve into that supreme position of Vishnu
meaning.hi: वह मन विष्णु के परम पद में विलीन होता है

meaning.en: through that dissolving, a pure non-dual perfection results, free of any sense of division
meaning.hi: उस लय से शुद्धाद्वैत-सिद्धि, भेदाभाव से

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this alone is the highest truth
meaning.hi: यही परम तत्त्व है

meaning.en: one who knows this should move through the world like a child, an intoxicated person, or one possessed, acting without deliberate effort
meaning.hi: उसे जानने वाला बालोन्मत्त-पिशाचवत् जड़वृत्ति से लोक-आचरण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: through this practice of amanaska alone comes constant satisfaction, minimal waste, little food, strong limbs, freedom from dullness and excess sleep; through seeing Brahman, one attains the known nature of true happiness
meaning.hi: अमनस्क-अभ्यास से नित्य-तृप्ति, अल्प-मूत्र-पुरीष, दृढ़-अंग, जड्यता-निद्रा-रहित, ब्रह्म-दर्शन से सुख-स्वरूप-सिद्धि

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: such a one, devoted to drinking the nectar of Brahman born of prolonged absorption, becomes a renunciate, a supreme free-roaming ascetic
meaning.hi: चिरसमाधिजनित ब्रह्मामृत-पान-परायण सन्न्यासी परमहंस अवधूत होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: simply seeing such a person makes the entire world sacred
meaning.hi: उसके दर्शन से सम्पूर्ण जगत् पवित्र होता है

meaning.en: even one who is ignorant but devoted to serving him becomes liberated
meaning.hi: उसकी सेवा में रत अज्ञ भी मुक्त होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: such a one liberates a hundred and one generations of the family
meaning.hi: उसका कुल एकोत्तर-शत तारता है

words.sanskrit: tanmatripitrijayapatyavargam cha muktam bhavati iti upanishat

meaning.en: mother, father, spouse, and children are all freed; thus concludes the teaching of the Upanishad
meaning.hi: उसके माता-पिता-जाया-अपत्य-वर्ग भी मुक्त होते हैं; इति उपनिषत्

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
